visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black zip-up hoodie, is in a brightly lit indoor room. She uses a red and black hair styling tool on a lock of her hair. She shows a surprised expression with wide eyes and an open mouth as the curl forms perfectly. She touches her smooth, long hair. (2) The woman holds a large, sleek black storage box with a pink lid. She opens it to reveal the Dyson Airwrap i.d.™ multi-styler and its various attachments resting in their compartments. The background shows a simple, clean indoor interior. (3) Close-up shots show the red body of the styler with the 'dyson' logo and several attachments like a round brush and smoothers. The lighting is bright and studio-like, highlighting the metallic texture of the product. (4) The woman is now shown with a purple towel wrapped around her head. She uses a large hairdryer attachment to dry her damp hair. She holds the device close to her scalp, moving it around her head with a focused expression. (5) A screen recording of a smartphone appears, showing the 'Airwrap i.d.™' app interface. Fingers interact with the screen, adjusting settings for wrapping and styling durations. Several choice screens for hair profile and goals are shown. (6) The woman uses a long, tapered curling barrel. She holds the device vertically, and her hair wraps around it automatically. An app interface overlay shows a circular countdown timer. She shows a 'Before' and 'After' side-by-side comparison of her hair. (7) A quick montage shows her using different attachments to style her bangs and the back of her hair. She then holds up the power cord to show a QR code on a label. She ends the video by smiling and winking at the camera while holding the styler.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: POV:女生的PS5又來了. (2) [Variety]: !!. (3) [Variety]: 柔順. (4) [Slogan]: 手殘黨的救星降臨了！. (5) [Slogan]: Dyson Airwrap i.d.™ 智能吹風造型器. (6) [Subtitle]: 一台就可以達到 造型自由. (7) [Subtitle]: 重點是 可以讓你的頭髮 超級柔順. (8) [Subtitle]: 全套總共有六套配件 滿足所有的造型需求. (9) [Subtitle]: 我的用法是 洗完頭之後 先用「快速乾髮吹嘴」. (10) [Subtitle]: 吹乾髮根 吹到7-8成乾 接下來就可以直接造型啦~. (11) [Slogan]: i.d curl™ 個人化捲髮程序. (12) [Subtitle]: 有個很酷的地方是 Dyson 全新推出的 i.d curl™. (13) [Subtitle]: 透過藍牙連接 應用程式會根據你的髮質 還有理想的造型. (14) [Subtitle]: 去定製造型的流程 搭配全新的錐形持久髮捲. (15) [Subtitle]: 可以更深入髮根 捲的更實 更持久. (16) [Subtitle]: 看看這個捲度 是不是很可以. (17) [Subtitle]: 而且捲完 不會覺得頭髮超乾 是軟軟的感覺. (18) [Subtitle]: 粗硬髮的我就很有感. (19) [Subtitle]: 設定好數值之後 將電源開關向上輕推 吹就會自動完成捲髮程序. (20) [Subtitle]: 一鍵搞定上捲、塑型、冷風定型三個程序. (21) [Subtitle]: 完全不需要任何技巧 非常方便又省時！. (22) [Subtitle]: 智能定製造型流程 吹乾、捲髮、順直 一機到位！. (23) [Logo]: Dyson. (24) [Subtitle]: Dyson 為了安全 所以在變壓器的部分 是非常敏銳的. (25) [Subtitle]: 提醒大家還是要選擇 符合當地電壓的產品. (26) [Subtitle]: 也建議在台灣購買 有保固更安心喔~.
